title: Sales & Customer Service Representative
description_text:
About Us
Join the New Frontier Immigration Law
team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our fast-growing, mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems. 

Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here. 
Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here. 
Learn more about our Core Values here. 

Why Apply

Are you passionate about helping immigrant families build brighter futures?
You’ll thrive in this role if you bring both heart and hustle—a genuine care for people, paired with the motivation to hit goals and grow your career.
Purposeful Work – Every call you take could help a family stay together or find safety and opportunity.
Supportive Culture – Join a values-driven team that believes in hope, courage, and transformation.
Growth Opportunities – Learn immigration law basics, develop your consultative sales skills, and advance within a mission-driven firm.
Recognition & Incentives – Be rewarded for great work with individual and team bonuses.

Role Objective

We’re looking for a bilingual (English/Spanish) Sales and Customer Service Representative to join our growing team. This role blends empathetic customer service with performance-driven sales to guide individuals and families toward life-changing legal solutions.

Success Attributes: 

Sales-Driven with Heart – You have at least 3 years of proven experience in consultative or service-based sales, and you thrive on delivering results that truly matter.
Empathetic Communicator – You’re skilled at listening deeply, speaking clearly, and making people feel understood.
Mission-Aligned – You’re passionate about justice, dignity, and supporting immigrant communities.
Resilient & Self-Motivated – You can navigate emotionally charged conversations while maintaining focus and energy.
Highly Organized – You manage your time well, prioritize tasks effectively, and stay on top of systems and documentation.

Responsibilities 
Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound calls with empathy and professionalism.
Conduct thorough client needs assessments to identify how our services can help.
Convert qualified leads into initial consultations through a consultative, trust-building approach.
Meet or exceed performance goals, including sales conversions and call handling metrics.
Maintain accurate and timely notes in our CRM system.
Work closely with teammates to continuously improve client experience and sales strategy.
Navigate sensitive conversations with cultural awareness, discretion, and compassion.
Go the extra mile to engage customers


Required Background

The ideal candidate for this role must possess previous demonstrated success in sales.
Fluent bilingual skills in English and Spanish (native or near-native fluency)
Minimum 3 years of successful sales experience, preferably in service-based industries
Strong customer service background and phone communication skills
Ability to work some evenings/weekends, depending on client demand

Preferred Background
Experience in legal services, healthcare, insurance, or financial services
Background in high-volume phone-based environments such as call centers or client intake
Previous roles in education sales, real estate, or coaching programs
Familiarity with CRMs such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar platforms

Compensation

$16,000 - $18,000 MXN pesos/month (Net Salary)
Uncapped Commissions. Up to $12,000 - $22,000 per month.
8 hours per day, 2 off days per week.
100% Remote Work anywhere in Mexico.
Growth Opportunities.

Location
Querétaro, Querétaro (Remote)
Department
Sales
Employment Type
International Contractor
Minimum Experience
Experienced
Compensation
$18,000 - $30,000

title: Sales Manager
description_text:
Sales Manager
Always apply through our website:
https://www.podmarketinginc.com/careers/. We will reach out by email if you are selected for the next step. Either way, we appreciate your interest and the time you spent getting to know us.

Who Are You?
You’re a sales leader who thrives on building and developing high-performing teams. You enjoy the challenge of hitting ambitious targets, but just as importantly, you care about how the team gets there. Coaching, accountability, and continuous improvement are part of how you operate.

You’re comfortable living in the numbers. Pipeline health, forecasting, and performance metrics are tools you actively use to guide decisions and improve results. When you notice a gap in performance, you don’t ignore it; you dig in, figure out what’s going on, and help your team adjust.

At the same time, you’re a hands-on leader who leads by example. You know how to motivate people, run productive coaching conversations, and help sales reps sharpen their skills through role-play, feedback, and real-world guidance. You balance strategic thinking with day-to-day execution and enjoy helping a team consistently raise the bar.

Most importantly, you take ownership. You care about outcomes, you hold yourself and others accountable, and you take pride in building systems, processes, and habits that help a sales team perform at a high level.

What's The Role?
We’re looking for a Sales Manager to lead, coach, and scale a high-performing sales team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth, strengthening sales processes, and creating a culture of accountability and performance.

You’ll oversee team performance, pipeline health, and forecasting while ensuring the team is consistently working toward monthly and quarterly revenue targets. This role combines leadership and execution: you’ll spend time coaching your team, improving processes, and collaborating with other departments to ensure the sales function is operating effectively.

The right person for this role is both strategic and practical. You can step back and see how the system should work, but you’re also comfortable getting into the details to help your team close deals, manage their pipeline, and improve performance.

Responsibilities

Lead, recruit, onboard, and develop members of the sales team
Conduct regular one-on-one coaching sessions and team meetings to support development and address at-risk accounts
Monitor team performance and hold individuals accountable to established KPIs
Provide ongoing coaching, role-play, and training around objection handling and sales effectiveness
Provide feedback to leadership on market trends, customer insights, and opportunities
Collaborate with operations and other departments to improve reporting, processes, and overall efficiency
Own team revenue targets, including new business and/or MRR goals
Review pipeline activity and optimize pipeline management within Salesforce
Forecast revenue and identify risks or opportunities across weekly, monthly, and quarterly cycles
Identify performance gaps and implement strategies to improve results

Required Experience & Skills

Legally able to work in Canada and located in Calgary, AB.
3–7+ years of experience in sales, including at least 2 years in a leadership or team management role.
Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent corporate work experience.
2+ years of experience in customer service or hospitality.
Strong understanding of marketing strategies, including PPC, SEO, social media, and email marketing
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
Strong experience using CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
Excellent coaching, communication, and leadership skills.
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and forecast revenue.
Experience in dental, aesthetics, or eye care industries is considered an asset.

Who is POD Marketing?
POD Marketing is a full-service agency that works across marketing, consulting, and HR to help clients solve real business challenges.

Behind that work is an incredible group of people. We put just as much care into supporting our team as we do our clients, creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and inspired to do their best work. This role sits within our Dental and Eye Care divisions (SmileShop Dental Marketing and Marketing4ECPs), working directly with practice owners to build and execute marketing strategies for their practices.

At POD, culture isn’t about perks (though we have those too). It’s about how you feel at work: accepted for who you are, encouraged to grow, and surrounded by people who want to see you succeed. That approach has earned us multiple awards, including recognition as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures.

To learn more about our culture, watch this video: https://youtu.be/1WZ8tAnATNs, visit the POD Marketing YouTube channel and check out our reviews on Glassdoor.

What's in it for You?
At POD Marketing, we work hard, have fun, and genuinely support each other. We believe people do their best work when they feel valued, trusted, and balanced; and we’ve built an environment that makes that possible.

You’ll enjoy three weeks of paid vacation, twelve flex days, a Passion Day to spend however you choose, and a company-wide MeMonday to prioritize mental health. We offer a thirty-day remote work policy for when you need a change of scenery, twenty-six hours of paid volunteer time each year, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, vision, and spending accounts.

Growth and development are part of life here. You’ll have access to mentorship, leadership programs like LEAD, and ongoing learning opportunities designed to help you grow your skills and career. You’ll also have regular one-on-one check-ins, quarterly performance conversations, and a culture of continuous feedback that keeps you supported and clear on expectations.

Our downtown Calgary office is bright, modern, and stocked with good coffee, snacks, and great people. We offer discounts with local vendors and a culture that’s collaborative, energetic, and built on trust and respect.

How to Apply
At POD, we believe “that most job requirements and conceptual knowledge are easily trainable. But you can’t teach drive, ambition, or passion.” (Take a look at this article, Finding Your Unicorn, written by our President, Kevin Wilhelm). Our hiring managers consider alignment with our core values and passion for our company culture to be as valuable as experience and education. 

Finding the right fit is important to us, and we put real care into reviewing applications. This is your chance to show us who you are: your voice, your attention to detail, and your excitement about joining the team. Take a few extra minutes to help us see why this opportunity is the right fit for you.

We often see strong candidates miss out because of preventable issues like missing cover letters, referencing the wrong job title or company, or submitting unedited AI-generated content. We encourage the use of AI to streamline your process, but your application should still reflect your voice and accuracy. If this role excites you, let that show in how you apply.

A few tips to stand out:
Submit an up-to-date resume that highlights the skills and experience we are looking for
Include a personalized cover letter or a video cover letter (one is required, both are not necessary)
Share why this specific role excites you and how your background connects to it
Make sure your application is error-free (especially the basics like company name and job title)
Answer the application questions with intention. Your responses don't need to be long; quality over quantity matters!
If you use AI, review and edit so it sounds like you and is factually correct (no - passion and innovation are not our core values, no matter what ChatGPT tells you)
Review the posted salary range before you apply and make sure it aligns with what you’re comfortable with
If you choose to submit a video cover letter, keep it short and engaging (under 2 minutes, please!)

Always apply through our website: https://www.podmarketinginc.com/careers/. We will reach out by email if you are selected for the next step. Either way, we appreciate your interest and the time you spent getting to know us.

We consider and evaluate all qualified candidates based on their qualifications without discrimination based on race, colour, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

description_text:
Who we are: 
Reliable Controls is dedicated to reducing the carbon footprint of buildings around the world. Our team specializes in the design, development, and assembly of building automation controls and software programs. We're working hard to create solutions for building operators to enable the vision of Net-Zero Emissions by 2050. 

We align ourselves with the right people and empower them in the right ways. An established company based in Victoria, BC, we nurture a strong culture of communication, trust, and collaboration. Embracing a work–life balance, promoting continuous learning, and celebrating our achievements are a few of the ways we show our enduring commitment to employees. 
Your mission: 
As a Software Developer, Engineering at Reliable Controls you’ll design and implement intelligent building control systems that help our customers achieve aggressive green initiatives. Specifically, you'll develop the software that our customers use for the engineering phase of their projects. Our products leverage data modeling, fault detection and diagnostics, identity and access management, and domain business knowledge. Using domain driven development, SOLID and clean architecture principles, and modern design patterns, you’ll help us build world-class software services and efficient, autonomous building management systems. 
In this role you will: 
Design, estimate, review, test, debug, and document code 
Support and guide our software development life cycle processes 
Collaborate in Scrum meetings and help drive team activities 
Address customer support and technical support issues when needed 
Support and mentor others in their work efforts and outcomes 
Address software architectural considerations 
Monitor, assess, and address technical debt 
Guide good coding practices and rules, and identify items for improvement

At least 3 years experience in developing C++ applications
A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field 
Web development experience with an understanding of mobile frameworks
Experience in embedded web development framework (i.e. Chromium, WebView2) 
Experience in Web Development using HTML, CSS, and component-based JavaScript frameworks Vue, React, etc.) 
Experience with Git, TFS, and Visual Studio Code 
Experience with automated unit/functional testing 
Agile software development experience (Scrum, Kanban) 
Strong communication skills 
You’ll be successful in this position if you: 
Are an enthusiastic, innovative individual who cares about sustainability

Like a challenge and want to grow professionally

A competitive extended health and dental plan for you and your family 
A yearly RRSP contribution on the company’s behalf, plus employee contribution matching to support your financial growth

Learning, Mentorship & Growth: We offer $2,000 per year reimbursement for learning and development related to your role, mentorship from experienced team members, and development pathways to help you grow. 
Recognition & Celebration: We celebrate excellence with awards and recognition for both long service and outstanding achievements. At Reliable Controls, success is a team effort, and we make sure it’s shared and celebrated. 
Purpose-Driven Innovation: At Reliable Controls, innovation means creating sustainable, meaningful solutions that make buildings smarter and the world greener. Every project you work on contributes to a legacy of environmental responsibility and global impact. 


The full compensation band for this role is $77,000 - 119,000 CAD annually. Please note that the hiring range for this position is expected to be between $89,250 – $97,500 CAD. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

description_text:
Vice President of Human Resources (Remote within Ottawa)

About Multiview 
Multiview is The Healthcare ERP Company. Purpose-built for healthcare finance teams, Multiview delivers a powerful, scalable, and cost-effective ERP that unites financials, supply chain management, reporting, and analytics in a single platform. Backed by deep expertise in healthcare finance and recognized by KLAS Research as the #1 ERP for healthcare organizations under 300 beds, Multiview helps mid-sized healthcare organizations gain clarity, move faster, make better decisions, and stay focused on care. 
We are a values-led organization: 

People First. Client Obsessed. Stronger Together. Work Smart. Believe in Better. 
The Opportunity 

Multiview is seeking a Vice-President of Human Resources to lead our HR organization as we scale. Reporting directly to CEO Mike Johnson, the VP of HR will join the senior leadership team at a pivotal moment in our evolution, helping to drive and build an environment where great people do great work, leaders lead well, and high performance is both supporter and expected. 
We are a proud award-winning employer and intend to continue to improve the company as a place to work so that we can be worthy of the incredible talent we have. 
This is a business leadership role first and a people leadership role second — someone who leads with business outcomes, builds high performance systems, and then intentionally aligns people, culture, and capability to deliver results.
This role is not suited for someone who prefers delegation or high-level oversight alone. The VP of HR must be eager to roll up their sleeves, dive into day-to-day HR activities, and personally influence the employee experience across the company. 

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. 

If you bring strong HR leadership, a passion for people, and a willingness to work directly at both strategic and tactical levels, we want to hear from you. 
Key Responsibilities: 
The Vice President of Human Resources is responsible for: 
Driving organizational performance through people strategy, talent systems, and leadership effectiveness 
Embedding a culture of accountability, growth, and continuous improvement 
Ensuring people practices actively enable Multiview’s business strategy, not simply support it 
This leader will partner closely with the CEO and executive team to ensure that strategy, structure, talent, and culture are fully aligned. 
You will also lead and deliver strategies in: 

Executive & Business Leadership 
Act as a strategic advisor to the CEO and the leadership team, using data and insight to drive better business outcomes. 
Support the translation of business strategy into clear people priorities, capability requirements, and workforce plans. 
Help leaders across the organization strengthen performance, decision making, and accountability within their teams. 


High Performance Culture 
Lead the intentional design and rollout of a high performance operating culture, including: 
Clear role expectations and ownership 
Performance standards aligned to business outcomes 
Supporting leaders on providing candid, growth oriented feedback 
Strong leadership capability at all levels 
Ensure performance management systems are meaningful, consistent, and tied directly to business impact. 


People Strategy & Execution 
Own and continuously evolve Multiview’s people strategy, ensuring alignment with annual operating plans and long term growth plans. 
Balance HR’s role as a compliance function with its responsibility as a performance enabling business partner. 
Regularly assess the impact of people initiatives and adjust based on results, feedback, and business needs. 


Talent & Capability 
Develop and execute strategies across: 
Talent acquisition: Owns the talent acquisition process that includes hiring leaders and individual contributors who raise the bar and strengthen culture. 
Learning & development: Building leadership capability, succession strength, and career progression paths. 
Rewards & incentives: Designing compensation and reward systems that reinforce performance, accountability, and retention of top talent, while maintaining pay equity legislation and principles across the organization. 


Team Leadership 
Lead, coach, and develop the Human Resources team to operate as trusted business partners. 
Build a function that models high performance, continuous learning, and execution excellence and is looked at as a trusted resource by all departments. 
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

As the leader within HR and a leader across the organization, you will be a model of our People First philosophy. 
The ideal candidate will: 
Think like a business leader and act like a people leader. 
Be comfortable challenging assumptions, influencing outcomes, and raising standards. 
Have experience leading the HR / People function during growth or change.
Have experience helping a company scale from roughly 200 to 400+ employees (or similar complexity) 
Be deeply credible with executives while remaining approachable and trusted across the company. 
Understand both Canadian and US employment environments (hands on experience preferred). 
Bring a drive for action, clarity, and measurable impact. 
SOFT SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES: 
Bachelor’s degree/diploma in HR or a related field, or equivalent experience. 
CHRP, CHRL, or equivalent experience/certification. 
Minimum 10 years of HR experience, including 5+ years leading HR in a growing organization. 
Strong knowledge of Canadian provincial employment legislation; US employment knowledge is an asset. 
Exceptional communication skills across diverse groups. 
High attention to detail.
Experience representing an organization internally and externally in alignment with values and culture. 
Demonstrated success building HR teams and fostering cultures of development and progression. 
Experience with HRIS tools and implementing relevant new technologies. 
Highest standards of discretion, confidentiality and ethical conduct. 
We recognize that experience comes in many forms. If your background is close to what we are seeking, we encourage you to apply. 
WORK ENVIRONMENT 
Highly collaborative, cross-functional work. 
Regular collaboration with CEO, senior leadership and all people leaders 
Remote-first work environment 
WHY JOIN MULTIVIEW? 
At Multiview, you can make a meaningful impact while growing your career in ways you might not have thought possible. We empower our employees through:

title: Paid Media Strategist
description_text:
Paid Media Strategist
Always apply through our website:
https://www.podmarketinginc.com/careers/. We will reach out by email if you are selected for the next step. Either way, we appreciate your interest and the time you spent getting to know us.

Who Are You?
You take ownership of your work and care about the results you deliver. You do not just run campaigns. You think critically about performance, ask questions, and look for ways to improve outcomes.
You are comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities at once without letting things slip. You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to move between strategy and execution while maintaining quality.
You are data-driven but not rigid. You use insights to guide decisions, test ideas, and continuously optimize performance. You are also collaborative. You communicate clearly, work well with others, and understand how your work fits into a broader strategy.
You want to grow. You stay current on trends, tools, and best practices, and you are motivated by the opportunity to refine your skill set and have a meaningful impact on client results.

What's The Role?
This is an opportunity to own and shape paid media performance across a portfolio of clients within a collaborative and evolving marketing environment.
You will be responsible for building, managing, and optimizing campaigns across multiple platforms, with both the autonomy to make decisions and the accountability for results. You will work closely with other teams to deliver integrated marketing strategies that drive real outcomes for clients.
This role also contributes to how we evolve our paid media product. You will support process improvements, refine how campaigns are executed, and help the team stay aligned with industry trends.
If you are looking for a role where you can deepen your expertise, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a high-performance team, this is a strong opportunity to do that.

Responsibilities

Strategically plan, create, and oversee all facets of digital advertising campaigns, including PPC, Google Display, YouTube, and Meta ads.
Manage a diverse portfolio of clients, delivering a tailored experience to meet their unique needs and ensure satisfaction and strong, long-term relationships.
Monitor and manage campaign finances diligently, ensuring adherence to budgets, forecasting monthly expenditures, and reconciling any financial discrepancies.
Uphold strict adherence to campaign deadlines, ensuring precise and accurate execution of all tasks.
Conduct detailed tracking, analysis, and reporting of website analytics using GA4 and other tools, as well as performance metrics for all paid advertising initiatives.
Implement conversion tracking by setting up and placing the appropriate codes on clients’ websites.
Work closely with cross-functional teams—including Paid Media, Sales, Web Development, Social Media, Content, and SEO—to manage client accounts and implement tailored marketing strategies.
Support process innovation to ensure campaigns run efficiently and effectively.
Continuously stay informed on industry trends and best practices to maintain innovative and competitive marketing strategies.

Required Experience & Skills

Legally able to work in Canada and located in Calgary, AB.
Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent corporate work experience.
2+ years of experience in SEM (Search Engine Marketing), managing PPC campaigns on Google, demonstrating a strong grasp of paid search strategies
2+ years of experience in customer service, hospitality, or client relationship management
High level of ownership - Brings a high level of care and attention
Experience with analytics and tracking tools such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager is an asset
Strong knowledge of Meta advertising
Analytical and data-driven mindset, with a good understanding of A/B testing and experience optimizing marketing strategies
Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, demonstrating strong project management and prioritization skills
Strong organizational skills to maintain systematic campaign management
Keen attention to detail, ensuring precision and accuracy in all aspects of work
Basic understanding of SEO principles is beneficial for integrating SEM with organic search strategies is considered an asset
Previous experience in an agency setting, demonstrating adaptability and client-focused experience is considered an asset
Experience with Fluency is considered an asset

Who is POD Marketing?
POD Marketing is a full-service agency that works across marketing, consulting, and HR to help clients solve real business challenges.

Behind that work is an incredible group of people. We put just as much care into supporting our team as we do our clients, creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and inspired to do their best work. This role supports our senior living marketing division, CITIZEN, where we work directly with senior living operators across North America to help them attract residents, build trust with families, and grow occupancy.

At POD, culture isn’t about perks (though we have those too). It’s about how you feel at work: accepted for who you are, encouraged to grow, and surrounded by people who want to see you succeed. That approach has earned us multiple awards, including recognition as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures.

To learn more about our culture, watch this video: https://youtu.be/1WZ8tAnATNs, visit the POD Marketing YouTube channel and check out our reviews on Glassdoor.

What's in it for You?
At POD Marketing, we work hard, have fun, and genuinely support each other. We believe people do their best work when they feel valued, trusted, and balanced; and we’ve built an environment that makes that possible.

You’ll enjoy three weeks of paid vacation, twelve flex days, a Passion Day to spend however you choose, and a company-wide MeMonday to prioritize mental health. We offer a thirty-day remote work policy for when you need a change of scenery, twenty-six hours of paid volunteer time each year, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, vision, and spending accounts.

Growth and development are part of life here. You’ll have access to mentorship, leadership programs like LEAD, and ongoing learning opportunities designed to help you grow your skills and career. You’ll also have regular one-on-one check-ins, quarterly performance conversations, and a culture of continuous feedback that keeps you supported and clear on expectations.

Our downtown Calgary office is bright, modern, and stocked with good coffee, snacks, and great people. We offer discounts with local vendors and a culture that’s collaborative, energetic, and built on trust and respect.

How to Apply
At POD, we believe “that most job requirements and conceptual knowledge are easily trainable. But you can’t teach drive, ambition, or passion.” (Take a look at this article, Finding Your Unicorn, written by our President, Kevin Wilhelm). Our hiring managers consider alignment with our core values and passion for our company culture to be as valuable as experience and education. 

Finding the right fit is important to us, and we put real care into reviewing applications. This is your chance to show us who you are: your voice, your attention to detail, and your excitement about joining the team. Take a few extra minutes to help us see why this opportunity is the right fit for you.

We often see strong candidates miss out because of preventable issues like missing cover letters, referencing the wrong job title or company, or submitting unedited AI-generated content. We encourage the use of AI to streamline your process, but your application should still reflect your voice and accuracy. If this role excites you, let that show in how you apply.

A few tips to stand out:
Submit an up-to-date resume that highlights the skills and experience we are looking for
Include a personalized cover letter or a video cover letter (one is required, both are not necessary)
Share why this specific role excites you and how your background connects to it
Make sure your application is error-free (especially the basics like company name and job title)
Answer the application questions with intention. Your responses don't need to be long; quality over quantity matters!
If you use AI, review and edit so it sounds like you and is factually correct (no - passion and innovation are not our core values, no matter what ChatGPT tells you)
Review the posted salary range before you apply and make sure it aligns with what you’re comfortable with
If you choose to submit a video cover letter, keep it short and engaging (under 2 minutes, please!)

Always apply through our website: https://www.podmarketinginc.com/careers/. We will reach out by email if you are selected for the next step. Either way, we appreciate your interest and the time you spent getting to know us.

At POD Marketing, we believe in creating an inclusive work environment, which is why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider and evaluate all qualified candidates based on their qualifications without discrimination based on race, colour, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Product Delivery and Technical Execution
Own and execute the engineering delivery plan, ensuring timely and predictable delivery against product goals.
Directly contribute to the technical design, solutioning, and development of complex features, ensuring alignment with architectural standards.
Lead the team in effectively utilizing Azure DevOps for comprehensive work tracking, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and reporting, driving transparency and execution efficiency.
Ensure the technical success of the team's output, actively tracking and improving key metrics related to performance, scalability, and security posture.
Proactively manage technical risks, technical debt, and dependencies, and guide the team in making pragmatic trade-offs.
Define, monitor, and report on key Engineering Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to delivery velocity, sprint commitment, and predictability, utilizing data to inform process improvements.


People and Resource Management

Own the resource capacity planning for the team, ensuring appropriate staffing and technical skill coverage to meet the delivery plan and business needs.
Mentor and provide guidance to team members on development practices, architectural patterns, and professional growth.
Drive a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning within the team.
Participate in the recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding of new engineering talent.
Mentor and provide guidance to Software Engineers, helping them to grow and succeed in their roles, providing regular performance indicators to leadership about individual performance and risk factors.
Conduct regular one-on-ones with direct reports to provide performance feedback, manage career development, and ensure their success and growth.


Process and Stakeholder Collaboration
Work with Product Managers, UX/UI designers, and Analysts to capture and refine technical requirements, translate them into actionable engineering tasks, and ensure accurate estimations.
Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring rigorous testing and high-quality product delivery to accurate specifications.
Collaborate closely with Scrum Masters to ensure adherence to Agile methodologies, resolve process roadblocks, and drive continuous process improvement within the delivery team.
Lead team rituals and working sessions, ensuring the team has the necessary context and information for informed decision-making.

Experience working closely with QA teams to ensure high quality, testable, and maintainable solutions
Experience defining and tracking engineering KPIs such as velocity, sprint predictability, and delivery metrics
Demonstrated experience in capacity planning, resource allocation, and engineering workforce management

Ability to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and actionable engineering tasks
Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical strategies, risks, and trade offs to senior leadership and cross functional stakeholders

Other Requirements

Quick learner and able to develop subject matter skills
Being able to manage multiple projects at the same time
Available for scheduled and ad-hoc calls/meetings/chats during weekdays working
Quiet workspace, conducive to video meetings & calls

Anytime Mailbox, a worldwide trailblazer in the virtual mailbox industry, enables individuals, small businesses, content creators, and digital nomads to establish a real street address with a mailbox at over 2,500 locations across the planet. A virtual mailbox eliminates having to be at a physical location to get postal mail while ensuring you'll never miss your mail. We are genuinely decentralized. Embracing work at home since 2013, we appreciate the value of a flexible schedule and work-life balance. description_text:
About SailGP Technologies:

SailGP Technologies is the high performance design, engineering and manufacturing arm of SailGP, the global purpose-led sail grand prix championship.

The Rolex SailGP Championship is the most exciting racing on water, where anything can happen in short, adrenaline-fueled battles between national teams at iconic stadium destinations worldwide. Top athletes fly in identical high-tech F50 catamarans faster than the wind, at speeds in excess of 100km/h (60mph). Founded in 2018, SailGP is one of the world’s fastest-growing sports and entertainment properties, now in its sixth season.
SailGP’s constantly evolving design, composites engineering, software and data expertise is rooted in decades of experience at the forefront of cutting-edge sail racing. Previously established and located in New Zealand since 2001, SailGP Technologies has relocated to Southampton, UK, with the new state of the art facility which opened in Spring 2024.

Job Summary:
As a Placement Student Engineer at SailGP Technologies, you will be embedded within the engineering team for a period of 12-months. You will contribute to real engineering and production work from early in the placement, building a practical understanding of the F50 platform and how it is designed, built, and maintained. You will work across both mechanical and structural areas within a small, highly collaborative team, supporting a range of tasks and gradually taking on more responsibility as your confidence and capability grow.

Programme Context & Development
You will join a team currently focused on the production and maintenance of the F50 fleet, as well as delivering a structured safety upgrade programme. Alongside this, there is an evolving pipeline of future developments, including a youth/feeder league boat and next-generation race marks and appendages. Initial work will focus on current F50 production delivery priorities, with opportunities to support development work as your experience grows. Working closely with experienced engineers, you will gain hands-on experience across design, analysis, and production, translating academic knowledge into practical engineering.

Key Responsibilities: 
Support engineering and production activities to develop a detailed understanding of the F50 platform and its systems
Contribute to the development and maintenance of the F50 digital twin through 3D modelling and 2D drawing updates
Assist with CAD modelling and drawing updates under guidance from design engineers
Support composite production activities, including ply book preparation, kit definition, and general build support
Assist with prototype builds, testing activities, and validation work
Support design changes and engineering updates across the existing fleet
Carry out engineering calculations and basic analysis tasks appropriate to your level of experience
Support material, component, and design investigations
Maintain clear and accurate engineering documentation and drawing records
Work across a variety of tasks and projects within a fast-paced environment

Key Expectations:
Get involved – take an active role in engineering work rather than waiting to be directed
Be curious – ask questions, seek feedback, and take the opportunity to learn from those around you
Be adaptable – work across a range of tasks rather than focusing on a single area
Work collaboratively – engage with others in a small team where informal interaction is key
Build confidence – develop practical skills and understanding throughout the placement

About you: 
Currently studying for a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Naval Architecture, or a closely related discipline
On track to achieve a 2:1 or higher
Some exposure to CAD (any major package) and basic engineering analysis or FEA through academic work
Interest in high-performance engineering, marine systems, or composite structures
Proactive, curious, and keen to get involved in practical engineering work
Comfortable working in a small team environment where you will be expected to engage and contribute

description_text:
About Us
Streamline Media Group is a 25-year creative development studio specializing in full video game development, co-development, publishing, and interactive digital asset production. We have shipped titles across every major platform for clients, including Sony, Microsoft, and global AAA publishers.
The company operates across Malaysia, the United States, and Japan, with partnerships in Latin America. We move fast and expect people to adapt quickly. Team members often wear multiple hats, and while processes exist, ownership and resourcefulness matter more. You will be expected to grow quickly with clear expectations and direct leadership.

We are also a technology-forward organization. Streamframe, our proprietary ERP and orchestration platform, manages projects, finances, contracts, and delivery across the company. AI tools are used actively, and everyone is expected to build working fluency with them. If you prefer to wait to be told what to learn, this is not the right environment.

Role Description
Streamline runs a lean finance function. As Finance Executive, you will support day-to-day financial operations across Malaysia, the United States, and Japan, ensuring documentation, reporting, and compliance remain audit-ready.

This role supports how funds move across the organization and helps ensure financial information reaches the right stakeholders. You will work closely with the Director of Finance and gain visibility into how the business operates. Streamframe will be your primary working environment, supported by Cowork and AI tools.
The role also requires coordination with internal teams and external partners, including bookkeepers, auditors, tax agents, and legal advisors, across multiple jurisdictions. This includes Malaysian statutory and EPF/KWSP obligations, US entity compliance, and Japan statutory filings. Experience with restructuring, entity formation, or multi-jurisdiction compliance environments will be valuable.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Operations
Handle accounts payable and receivable across all entities (Malaysia, US, Japan), including vendor payment scheduling, client invoicing, and collections follow-up.
Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready financial records, transaction data, and supporting documentation at all times.
Conduct regular bank reconciliations and maintain fixed asset registers across entities.
Manage multi-currency transactions (MYR, USD, JPY) and ensure accurate foreign exchange treatment.

Compliance & Statutory
Support tax and statutory submissions across jurisdictions as directed, including Malaysian SST, EPF/KWSP, SOCSO, and income tax filings.
Liaise with external bookkeepers, auditors, and tax agents to collect, verify, and submit required documentation on schedule.
Maintain awareness of compliance obligations across our US and Japan entities and flag upcoming deadlines proactively.
Support entity-level compliance work, including closures, restructuring, and new entity onboarding as directed by the Director of Finance and legal counsel.

Finance Orchestration & Systems
Operate Streamframe as a primary working tool — logging transactions, tracking project financials, coordinating approvals, and maintaining visibility for the finance team and leadership.
Maintain and improve workflows in Xero; assist with data access and organization in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Support the integration and adoption of the ICARUS finance tool as it is built into Streamframe — including data entry, reconciliation support, and process documentation.
Use Cowork and AI tools to automate routine tasks, improve reporting accuracy, and reduce manual processing time.
Identify process gaps and propose improvements — we expect this role to actively make our finance function smarter, not just maintain it.

Coordination & Communication
Respond promptly to internal finance queries from across the organization — production, HR, legal, and leadership.
Coordinate with external advisors on documentation, compliance queries, and reporting requirements.
Support preparation for the monthly Directors Council and FoMo financial reviews — ensuring relevant data is prepared, accurate, and ready for leadership discussion.
Flag financial risks, anomalies, or deadline pressures early — do not wait to be asked.

How Success is Measured

Finance Executives will be evaluated on the following dimensions:
Accuracy
Timeliness
Compliance
Coordination
System Adoption
Ownership


Job Skills
Required
Proficiency in Xero — day-to-day accounts operations, reconciliations, and reporting.
Strong Excel skills — formulas, pivot tables, multi-sheet reconciliations.
Solid understanding of accounting principles (GAAP/IFRS) and AP/AR processes.
Comfortable working with multi-currency transactions (MYR, USD, JPY).
Experience navigating Malaysian statutory obligations — EPF/KWSP, SOCSO, SST, income tax.
Detail-oriented and organized — able to manage multiple entities and deadlines simultaneously.
Comfortable in a VUCA (volatile, uncertain, complex, and ambiguous) environment where priorities can shift fast.
Open to and actively learning AI and automation tools — this is not optional.

Strongly Preferred
Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 — data access, reporting, or migration support.
Experience working within a proprietary ERP or project management system (Streamframe fluency will be developed on the job, but comfort with structured digital platforms matters).
Exposure to multi-entity corporate structures — including entity formation, restructuring, or statutory closures.
Familiarity with royalty accounting or IP licensing agreement financials.
Experience supporting or coordinating with external legal counsel on financial documentation.
Prior experience in gaming, media, creative production, or technology companies.


Nice to Have
ACCA, CPA, CA(M), or equivalent professional qualification — in progress or completed.
Exposure to US entity compliance (Nevada LLC or equivalent).
Experience with Japan statutory filings or working with Japanese corporate structures.
Interest in finance process automation, internal controls, or compliance frameworks.
Familiarity with cryptocurrency accounting or digital asset transactions.
What you will work with:
Tools & Systems:
Streamframe
Xero
Microsoft Dynamics 365
ICARUS
Cowork
AI Tools
Excel


What to expect:
We believe in being direct with candidates about what this role actually involves:
You will be working in a lean team where everyone pulls more than their formal job description. The person who says 'that's not my job' does not last here.
The first 90 days will be dense. You will be onboarding into Streamframe, getting across the financial state of multiple entities, and learning our compliance landscape simultaneously.
You will have real visibility into how a global creative company runs financially — including the hard parts. This is not a role where you sit behind a process and never see the business.
Leadership is accessible and direct. The CEO and the Director of Finance communicate clearly about priorities and will tell you when something is not working. We expect the same from you.
You will be expected to learn continuously. AI is changing finance workflows rapidly. The people who thrive here stay ahead of that curve, not behind it.
This is a hybrid role based in Kuala Lumpur. Some weeks are heavier than others. We do not glorify overwork, but we are honest that this is a demanding environment.

Streamline Values

Accountability We own our work and learn from mistakes to build trust and quality.
Discipline Routines, workflows, and schedules are our backbone.
Hard Work & Teamwork We finish together — quality, collaboration, and consistency are key.
Communication Clear, aligned, and consistent communication drives our efficiency.
Mastery We are committed to continuous improvement and excellence in our craft.
Curiosity & Learning The industry evolves constantly — we stay ahead by learning always.

title: Technical Writer
description_text:
Job Summary:
We are seeking a Technical Writer to develop comprehensive, structured, and user-friendly documentation for the Land Administration & Management Portal (LAMP), a digital platform designed to streamline land registration, record management, citizen services, and internal land department workflows.


The candidate must demonstrate strong fluency in both English and Urdu, with the ability to produce high-quality written content in both languages.

The role involves creating high-quality documentation for multiple user groups including government officers, administrative staff, field survey teams, system administrators, and external stakeholders. The Technical Writer will produce clear and standardized documentation in both English and Urdu to support system adoption, training, and operational efficiency.

Job Responsibility:
Documentation Development
Develop comprehensive User Manuals for all key modules of the LAMP system in English and Urdu.
Prepare Role-Based Guides for various system users such as ADLR, GIS Manager, SCO, SCI, and field staff.
Create step-by-step process documentation for critical system workflows.
Document system configuration procedures where applicable.
Functional Understanding & Content Gathering
Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, QA teams, and Project Managers to gather system information.
Attend functional walkthroughs, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Review project documentation including BRDs, SRS, and system specifications.
Supporting Documentation
Develop and maintain:
Master User Manual
Administrator Guide
End User Manual
Operational & Support Manual
Installation & Deployment Guide
Training Manuals
Role-Based Manuals
Configuration Manuals
Quick Reference Guides (QRGs)
FAQs and Troubleshooting Guides
API Integration Documentation
Visual & Structural Standards
Incorporate screenshots, process diagrams, and workflow illustrations to improve clarity.
Maintain consistent formatting, version control, and documentation standards.
Ensure compliance with defined branding and documentation guidelines.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with the Project Manager and functional teams.
Participate in documentation review sessions.
Incorporate stakeholder feedback and maintain updated documentation aligned with system releases.

Required Skills:
Strong technical writing and documentation skills
Excellent written communication in English and Urdu
Ability to translate complex technical information into clear and user-friendly documentation
Experience creating user manuals, training materials, and process documentation
Familiarity with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and documentation standards
Strong attention to detail and document structuring
Ability to create visual documentation elements such as flowcharts, diagrams, and screenshots
Experience with documentation tools such as MS Word, Visio, or similar tools

Required Experience:
3–5 years of experience in technical writing or documentation for software systems
Experience documenting enterprise systems, government systems, or large-scale platforms is preferred
Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, analysts, and QA teams

Education/Qualification:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Technical Communication, or a related field
Relevant technical writing certifications will be considered a plus
